problem: A rejected PB voltage/current admission cleared the only pending sample until the next 5-second acquisition.

behavior.policy: One latest value per channel; retry only failed channels; retire stale acquisition; retain acquisition age across current network clock mapping.

regressions: Admission rejection recovers at 100ms without acquiring another sample
Expired data is not retried or re-stamped as fresh
Concurrent acquisition wins over failed old publication
Successful channel does not replay during other channel failure
Permanent pressure is capped at 10 attempts per second
Explicit UTC and router-relative timestamps retain acquisition age

build.profile: Copied frozen PB cohort SDK; TLSF, board watchdog, SIM_TEST ON; additive build directory

limitations: Native regression and cross-build are not physical sensor-to-GS qualification.
No sampling rates, stale thresholds, queue budgets, or SDK release changed.
